title: The Flock Doomed to Slaughter

questions.question: Open your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour your...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:1 (ESV): "Open your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars!"

questions.question: Wail, O cypress, for the cedar has fallen, for the glorious trees are ruined! Wail, oaks of Bashan, for the... has been felled!
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:2 (ESV): "Wail, oaks of Bashan, for the thick forest has been felled!"

questions.question: The sound of the wailing of the shepherds, for their... is ruined!
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:3 (ESV): "The sound of the wailing of the shepherds, for their glory is ruined!"

questions.question: Thus said the Lord my God: "Become shepherd of the flock doomed to..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:4 (ESV): "shepherd of the flock doomed to slaughter."

questions.question: Zechariah took two staffs; one he named Favor, the other he named...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:7 (ESV): "And I took two staffs. One I named Favor, the other I named Union."

questions.question: How many shepherds did Zechariah destroy in one month?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:8 (ESV): "In one month I destroyed the three shepherds."

questions.question: Zechariah became impatient with the flock, and he said, "I will not be your shepherd. What is to die, let it die. What is to be destroyed, let it be destroyed. And let those who are left..."
options: Devour the flesh of one another
questions.correctAnswer: Devour the flesh of one another
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:9 (ESV): "And let those who are left devour the flesh of one another."

questions.question: Which staff did Zechariah take and break, annulling the covenant he had made with all the peoples?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:10 (ESV): "And I took my staff Favor, and I broke it, annulling the covenant that I had made with all the peoples."

questions.question: Then he said to them, "If it seems good to you, give me my wages; but if not, keep them." And they weighed out as his wages...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:12 (ESV): "And they weighed out as my wages thirty pieces of silver."

questions.question: What did the Lord tell Zechariah to do with the thirty pieces of silver?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:13 (ESV): "Then the Lord said to me, 'Throw it to the potter'—the lordly price at which I was priced by them."

questions.question: Where was the thirty pieces of silver thrown?
options: Into the house of the Lord, to the potter
questions.correctAnswer: Into the house of the Lord, to the potter
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:13 (ESV): "So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them into the house of the Lord, to the potter."

questions.question: Which staff did Zechariah break second, annulling the brotherhood between Judah and Israel?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:14 (ESV): "Then I broke my second staff Union, annulling the brotherhood between Judah and Israel."

questions.question: Then the Lord said to him, "Take once more the equipment of a..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:15 (ESV): "Then the Lord said to me, 'Take once more the equipment of a foolish shepherd.'"

questions.question: "For behold, I am raising up in the land a shepherd who does not care for those being destroyed, or seek the young or heal the maimed... but devours the flesh of the fat ones, tearing off even their..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:16 (ESV): "but devours the flesh of the fat ones, tearing off even their hooves."

questions.question: "Woe to my worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May the sword strike his arm and his..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 11:17 (ESV): "May the sword strike his arm and his right eye! Let his arm be wholly withered, his right eye utterly blinded!"

key_verse_text: Then I said to them, "If it seems good to you, give me my wages; but if not, keep them." And they weighed out as my wages thirty pieces of silver. Then the Lord said to me, "Throw it to the potter"—the lordly price at which I was priced by them. So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them into the house of the Lord, to the potter.
